comparison_layers.purpose: Compare durable intent, retry/idempotency, recipient commit, verified receipts and terminal outcome semantics under identical fault schedules.

non_compensable_gates: zero false SUCCESS_VERIFIED claims in the frozen in-domain corpus
zero duplicate recipient logical effects for one idempotency key
zero silent loss of an acknowledged durable outbox state within the declared storage model
zero host authorization widening across cell, grantee, function or capability kind
zero post-revocation host admission in non-overlapping tests
zero silent downgrade to a weaker or unqualified cryptographic profile
zero plaintext, raw secret or capability secret in telemetry
every unresolved outcome remains UNKNOWN or INCOMPLETE
reporting_rules: Do not combine hard safety gates with performance in a weighted score.
Do not equate transport ACK, server acceptance, DHT publication or relay receipt with recipient delivery.
Report capability unsupported, not implemented, unmeasured and failed as distinct statuses; never encode unsupported as zero cost or zero leakage.
Compare candidates only where protocol semantics, security guarantees and receipt semantics are matched.
Publish per-platform, per-workload and per-failure-domain results; do not hide regressions in averages.
A finite corpus result is limited to that corpus, environment, candidate build and stated threat model.
